entities.summary: Ismail Khan Ziyadkhanov or Ismail Khan Ziyadkhanly was a member of the government of the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic, a diplomat, and a lieutenant colonel in the army of the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic. He was one of the five Azerbaijanis elected to the First State Duma of the Russian Empire.
